name: Google BigQuery
shortInfo: Move data from any user determined warehouse into Google BigQuery
brief: Stream data from a user determined warehouse to Google Bigquery warehouse
about: Google is one of the most popular, scalable, easy to manage data warehouse options for those wanting to setup a Data Warehouse. Read more about the features and how to get started with the popular platform [here](https://cloud.google.com/bigquery?hl=en).
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/bigquery/syncs/export.html)

This sync can be used to load data from your data warehouse into Google BigQuery platform.
